name: heat-food
title: Heat food
signature: heat(food: object_ref, appliance: appliance_ref, temp_c: number)
description: Bring food to a target temperature with an appliance and switch the heat off: in the closed microwave (start key + wait) or in a pot on the stove burner (power key on, wait, power key off).
use_when: Food must reach a target temperature with the microwave or the stove.

food.description: The food item (has task-level thermal state).

applicability.summary: Requires hand_empty(hand=right); base_near(place=$appliance). Some bound nouns add preconditions (see Conditions that depend on the bound nouns).

preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

postconditions.meaning: Task-level food temperature at or above the threshold.
The appliance's heat source is on (microwave cycle or stove burner).

preconditions.meaning: Object centre inside the appliance cavity box (microwave) or body box (refrigerator).
Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.
Food is inside a container whose bottom rests on the stove burner disc (or on the disc itself).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

arg_formats.appliance_ref: an articulated appliance with a thermal role (microwave, refrigerator)

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
